Why builders bring us in early

Fewer surprises. A stronger handoff.

Technology decisions affect framing, power, cooling, millwork and finish work. Resolving them before the walls close protects the schedule and the design.

01

Prevent expensive rework

Pathways, rack locations, power, access points, displays and control locations are coordinated before rough-in and finish work.

02

Create a repeatable standard

Defined base systems, upgrade paths and responsibility lines make technology easier to price, sell and reproduce across multiple properties.

03

Close with confidence

Every system is tested, commissioned and documented before handoff, with homeowner training and a clear post-close support path.

How the relationship works

Integrated into the construction process.

Warrior speaks both construction and technology. We coordinate with the project team, own the low-voltage scope and remain accountable after occupancy.

01

Preconstruction

Review plans, define the infrastructure standard, identify decisions and establish scope boundaries.

02

Rough-in coordination

Coordinate cabling, power, millwork, device locations and site conditions with the trades.

03

Integration + commissioning

Install, program, test and tune the network and connected systems as one property platform.

04

Closeout + support

Deliver documentation, homeowner orientation and an optional managed-service relationship.
